issues.issue: Did the RPD err in applying Article 1E exclusion due to appellant's permanent resident status in Brazil?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant argues Haitians face hostile conditions unlike nationals, so Article 1E should not apply.
issues.respondent_position: RPD found permanent resident status grants rights similar to nationals, triggering Article 1E exclusion.
issues.result_text: RAD finds no error in RPD's conclusion on appellant's status and Article 1E application.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in assessing the appellant's fear of returning to Brazil as a fear of persecution?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant claims RPD failed to consider racism endured and particular circumstances causing fear of persecution.
issues.respondent_position: RPD found isolated incidents not linked to race or nationality; no well-founded fear of persecution shown.
issues.result_text: RAD finds appellant has not established a well-founded fear of persecution or serious rights violations in Brazil.
